_doc: Experiment definitions. Each entry resolves to odometry_train.py arguments: --config configs/odometry.json, --data <data>, then 'args'. Shared blocks are referenced by name in 'use'. Decision gates are declared before results exist.

budget.note: 12 epochs x 244 windows (batch 1, accumulation 2). Identical for every D run regardless of dataset size.

selection_rule: Checkpoint = epoch with the lowest selection_score (mean of nominal and 5 s moving-start unaligned ATE on the fixed development roster) evaluated on EMA weights. Last checkpoint retained for diagnostics.

gates.screen_improvement: At least 10% lower equal-flight mean unaligned development ATE than the paired control (engineering gate, not statistical significance).
gates.ordinary_motion_guardrail: No more than 5% regression on ordinary-motion (benchmark-regime, non-yaw) development flights.
gates.advance: Runs passing both gates advance to three paired seeds (217, 218, 219).
gates.domain_followup: If D1/D2 fail the native-development gate but improve on the proxy-validation holdout, run D1n/D2n to separate motion coverage from reduced native exposure (21.3% in D0 vs 4.4% in D1/D2).
gates.architecture_block: T-series runs use D0 data and recipe; each is compared scene-paired to D0-ssm (seed 217) with the same screen (>=10% lower dev mean unaligned ATE), the ordinary-motion guardrail, and the 30 s proxy-validation criterion as a second, independent check. If the D-series selects expanded data, the T-series is rerun on it instead.
gates.native_campaign_block: N1-ssm-x3 vs B-D0-ssm-x3, three seeds each, decided on three-seed means: screen >=10% lower development mean unaligned ATE and the ordinary-motion guardrail; independent checks are the 30 s proxy-validation criterion and campaign-dev (new flights in ProcTHOR 166-171 and in 15 never-used HSSD Val43 houses, reported separately). The reserved campaign test split (ProcTHOR 162-165/172-175, 28 HSSD Val43 houses) stays unscored.
gates.visual_attitude_block: Freeze the B-D0 best checkpoints for seeds 217/218/219 and replay their exact same body-frame velocities through baseline and causal visual-corrected attitude. Use 0.5 s non-overlapping image pairs; require spatially spread forward/backward LK tracks, gate the direct rotation fit to low residual flow, and use a translation-aware essential-matrix fit only with adequate cheirality, support, and estimated parallax. Apply 0.35 gain and reject corrections over 0.12 rad. Primary dev gate: >=10% lower three-seed mean unaligned ATE and <=5% regression on ordinary flights and each start group. Report nominal/static and 5 s moving starts separately; check campaign-dev 30 s by catalog and start. Only passing candidates advance to hybrid on the learned-attitude rotations, holding that candidate's velocities fixed between hybrid arms, and to C/C++ WebAssembly peak fuel measurement. No reserved-test replay.
gates.proxy_validation_criterion: Declared 2026-11-18 ~15:30, before any D1/D2 result: the proxy-validation holdout is scored on each replay's first 30 s (benchmark flight length; odometry_eval.py --set proxy-val --max-seconds 30), scene-paired against the control. The full 90 s score is a long-horizon diagnostic only: there even true velocity through our attitude scores 1.04 m, so it mostly measures attitude drift.

datasets.teacher-full: D0 restricted control: the exact old teacher roster (48 proxy base + 12 native + 1 native yaw parents, crops 0/5 s), development roster of 7 native parents.
datasets.d1-expanded-tiers: D1/D2: all 280 eligible proxy training parents (base/mid/agile) + the same 13 native training parents; identical development roster.
datasets.d1-expanded-tiers-labeled: Same shards and splits as d1-expanded-tiers, with domain/tier labels from the audited ledger (needed for domain_share).

D1n-ssm.note: Follow-up (declared 09:40 before D results): expanded tiers with native share pinned to D0's 21.3%, startup/uniform windows only.

D2n-ssm.note: Follow-up: balanced motion mixture plus native share pinned to 21.3%.

T-ssm4.note: Architecture block (declared 2026-11-18 before D1/D2 results; control D0-ssm, same data/recipe/budget): 4-layer SSM, 1.432M params.

T-grussm.note: Hybrid: 1 residual GRU then 1 SSM block, 1.313M.

T-ssm-w240.note: 12 s scored context (240 frames + 32 burn-in), 66 windows/epoch so scored frames match the budget within 1.4% (66x240=15,840 vs 244x64=15,616 per epoch; the original sampler needs an even count, so the first launch with 65 crashed). Optimizer updates are fewer; that is the cost of longer context at equal data exposure.

B-D0-ssm-x3.note: Budget follow-up (declared 2026-11-18 ~19:00 after D results, before running): D0 at 3x optimizer updates (4,392). D0 was still improving steeply at epoch 12 and D1/D2 saw each parent ~5x less often, so equal-budget results may reflect undertraining of the larger dataset.

B-D2-ssm-x3.note: Budget follow-up: D2 at 3x updates. Gate: same screen and guardrail against B-D0-ssm-x3 (equal budget), plus the 30 s proxy-validation criterion.

P-imu-blind.note: Probe (plan step 6): D0-ssm with direct IMU features zeroed (frame interval kept). Measures what the network takes from the IMU beyond derotation; compare with D0-ssm and gru-blind (images blanked).

B-D2n-ssm-x3.note: Domain follow-up triggered by the predeclared rule (2026-11-18 ~21:40): B-D2-ssm-x3 failed the native dev gate (3-seed mean 1.250 vs 1.095) but improved the 30 s proxy-validation holdout (1.128 vs 1.276, non-overlapping seed ranges). D2's balanced mixture with native share pinned to D0's 21.3%, 3x budget, seeds 217/218/219.

N2-ssm-x3.note: Declared 2026-11-18 ~22:00 before composing its data: expanded proxy tiers (d1-expanded-tiers-labeled) plus the 592 campaign train parents, D2's balanced motion mixture, 3x budget, seeds 217/218/219. Compared with N1-ssm-x3 and B-D0-ssm-x3 under the native-campaign block's gates.

N1-ssm-x3.note: Native campaign (declared 2026-11-18 ~20:30, before the data were composed): teacher-full-labeled plus the campaign's train flights (ProcTHOR 0-9/46-149/180-199 + HSSD Train125, 30-90 s, 25% independent yaw). Control B-D0-ssm-x3 at the same 4,392 updates. Seeds 217/218/219 for both arms.

arms: none: integrate raw gyro, zero bias
first: freeze bias at first accepted rolling window
frozen_bias_ablation.dataset: campaign-dev only, 120 existing crop replays, no reserved tests
frozen_bias_ablation.primary: mean unaligned ATE at 30 seconds and full; report 60-second prefixes only where available
frozen_bias_ablation.exploratory_screen: at least 10% lower mean at 30s and full, ordinary/catalog/historical start groups no more than 5% regression; original dev and proxy gates unchanged and required before qualification
frozen_bias_ablation.mechanism: Remove later false-stationary gyro bias updates; differs from failed visual rotation fit and EKF. Earlier raw gyro oracle is motivation, frozen predicted velocity is new measured intervention. No new learned weights.
frozen_bias_ablation.interaction: Freeze original image derotation and IMU model inputs for isolation; complete system must later regenerate both with new orientation before deployment. No artifact qualifies based solely on frozen-velocity result.
frozen_bias_ablation.fuel: No whole guest implementation unless screen passes; no kernel extrapolation
frozen_bias_ablation.parity: raw reconstruction control must match prepared R <=1e-6; replay prefix must equal corresponding full prefix
